newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman approves new $519.6 mln industrial bank.
newsitem.headline: Oman approves new $519.6 mln industrial bank.

text.p: Oman's Central Bank has approved the setting up of a new industrial bank with a paid capital of 200 million rials ($519.6 million), a newspaper reported on Saturday.
The Times of Oman said the new bank would be named The Industrial Bank of Oman which would finance industrial projects by providing working capital and long-term credit facilities.
The bank, a joint stock company, will also get involved in evaluating industrial projects, issuing shares and promissory notes and other services.
Sixty percent of the shares will be held by the founders and the balance will be offered on the Muscat Securities Exchange, the newspaper reported. It did not give a date for the offering.
